license_required.quote: Any person who performs the functions and duties of a bail bond agent in this state without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter... is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: Not have been convicted of a crime in any jurisdiction in the preceding ten years, if the director determines that the applicant's particular crime directly relates to a capacity to perform the duties of a bail bond agent and the director determines that the license should be withheld to protect the citizens of Washington state.

required.quote: An applicant must meet the following minimum requirements to obtain a bail bond agent license: (1) Be at least eighteen years of age; (2) Not have been convicted of a crime... (3) Be employed by a bail bond agency or be licensed as a bail bond agency; and (4) Pay the required fee.

experience_source.quote: An applicant must meet the following minimum requirements to obtain a bail bond agent license: (1) Be at least eighteen years of age; (2) Not have been convicted of a crime... (3) Be employed by a bail bond agency or be licensed as a bail bond agency; and (4) Pay the required fee.

exams.name: Bail Bond Agency Examination
exams.notes: Required for agency (qualified agent) license; or may be waived with 3 years of relevant experience. Not explicitly required for basic bail bond agent license.
exams.quote: Pass an examination determined by the director to measure the person's knowledge and competence in the bail bond agency business;

exams.name: Bail Bond Recovery Agent Examination
exams.notes: Required for bail bond recovery agent license.
exams.quote: Pass an examination determined by the director to measure his or her knowledge and competence in the bail recovery business;

required.quote: The director may establish, by rule, continuing education requirements for bail bond agents.

available.quote: A bail bond recovery agent from another state who is not licensed under this chapter may not perform the functions of a bail bond recovery agent in this state unless the agent is working under the direct supervision of a licensed bail bond recovery agent.

requirements.value: Out-of-state bail bond recovery agents may only operate in WA under direct supervision of a WA-licensed bail bond recovery agent; no reciprocity/endorsement provision found for bail bond agents.
requirements.quote: A bail bond recovery agent from another state who is not licensed under this chapter may not perform the functions of a bail bond recovery agent in this state unless the agent is working under the direct supervision of a licensed bail bond recovery agent.

exists.quote: The director may appoint an advisory committee consisting of representatives from the bail bond industry and a consumer to assist in the development of rules to implement and administer this chapter.

name.quote: The director may appoint an advisory committee consisting of representatives from the bail bond industry and a consumer to assist in the development of rules to implement and administer this chapter.

authority.value: advisory only — assists in the development of rules to implement and administer the chapter
authority.quote: to assist in the development of rules to implement and administer this chapter

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who performs the functions and duties of a bail bond agent in this state without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter... is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: The director shall issue a bail bond agent license card to each licensed bail bond agent.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who performs the functions and duties of a bail bond agent in this state without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter... is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Any person who performs the functions and duties of a bail bond agent in this state without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, or any person presenting or attempting to use as his or her own the license of another... is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who performs the functions and duties of a bail bond agent in this state without being licensed in accordance with the provisions of this chapter... is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provisions of the chapter or rules adopted under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of this chapter or the rules adopted under this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet the qualifications set forth in the licensure requirements sections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet the qualifications set forth in RCW 18.185.020, 18.185.030, and 18.185.250;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly committing or being party to material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, or collusion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly committing, or being a party to, any material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, collusion, trick, scheme, or device whereby any other person lawfully relies upon the word, representation, or conduct of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assigning or transferring any license issued under the chapter, except as provided.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assigning or transferring any license issued pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, except as provided in RCW 18.185.030 or 18.185.250;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Converting money or property held in trust or on condition for one's own or another's use.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conversion of any money or contract, deed, note, mortgage, or other evidence of title, to his or her own use or to the use of his or her principal or of any other person, when delivered to him or her in trust or on condition, in violation of the trust or before the happening of the condition;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep records, maintain a trust account, or return collateral or security as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep records, maintain a trust account, or return collateral or security, as required by RCW 18.185.100;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct in a bail bond transaction demonstrating bad faith, dishonesty, or untrustworthiness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct in a bail bond transaction which demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, or untrustworthiness;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order to cease and desist issued by the director.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of an order to cease and desist that is issued by the director under chapter 18.235 RCW;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wearing, displaying, holding, or using badges not approved by the department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wearing, displaying, holding, or using badges not approved by the department;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making statements that would cause another person to believe the bail bond recovery agent is a sworn peace officer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any statement that would reasonably cause another person to believe that the bail bond recovery agent is a sworn peace officer;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to carry or present a copy of the contract as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to carry a copy of the contract or to present a copy of the contract as required under RCW 18.185.270(1);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the services of an unlicensed bail bond recovery agent or using services without proper contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the services of an unlicensed bail bond recovery agent or using the services of a bail bond recovery agent without issuing the proper contract;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting or knowingly making a material misstatement or omission in the license application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting or knowingly making a material misstatement or omission in the application for a license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the services of a person performing bail bond recovery agent functions without the required department license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the services of a person performing the functions of a bail bond recovery agent who has not been licensed by the department as required by this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing bail bond recovery agent functions without being licensed (or supervised) and under contract with a bail bond agent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing the functions of a bail bond recovery agent without being both (a) licensed under this chapter or supervised by a licensed bail bond recovery agent under RCW 18.185.290; and (b) under contract with a bail bond agent;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing bail bond recovery agent functions without exercising due care to protect the safety of others and their property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing the functions of a bail bond recovery agent without exercising due care to protect the safety of persons other than the defendant and the property of persons other than the defendant;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a dog in the apprehension of a fugitive criminal defendant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using a dog in the apprehension of a fugitive criminal defendant;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the position of bail bond recovery agent to enforce a civil immigration warrant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the position of a bail bond recovery agent to enforce a civil immigration warrant as defined in RCW 43.17.420;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep confidential a defendant's immigration status by sharing it outside the bail bond agency's business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep confidential by sharing a defendant's immigration status to anyone outside the bail bond agency's business.

bonding_required.quote: No bail bond agency license may be issued under the provisions of this chapter unless the qualified agent files with the director a bond, executed by a surety company authorized to do business in this state, in the sum of ten thousand dollars

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A person is guilty of a gross misdemeanor if the person owns or operates a bail bond agency in this state without first obtaining a bail bond agency license.

definition_quote.value: "Bail bond agent" means a person who is employed by a bail bond agency and engages in the sale or issuance of bail bonds, but does not mean a clerical, secretarial, or other support person who does not participate in the sale or issuance of bail bonds.
definition_quote.quote: "Bail bond agent" means a person who is employed by a bail bond agency and engages in the sale or issuance of bail bonds, but does not mean a clerical, secretarial, or other support person who does not participate in the sale or issuance of bail bonds.

value: providing security in the form of personal or real property
methods_authorized.quote: a business that sells and issues corporate surety bail bonds or that provides security in the form of personal or real property to ensure the appearance of a criminal defendant before the courts

agent_type_tiers.quote: "Licensee" means a bail bond agency, a bail bond agent, a qualified agent, or a bail bond recovery agent.

bail_enforcement_agent_license_available.quote: "Bail bond recovery agent" means a person who is under contract with a bail bond agent to receive compensation, reward, or any other form of lawful consideration for locating, apprehending, and surrendering a fugitive criminal defendant for whom a bail bond has been posted.

collateral_held_in_fiduciary_capacity.quote: Every qualified agent who receives collateral or security is a fiduciary of the property and shall keep adequate records for three years of the receipt, safekeeping, and disposition of the collateral or security.

collateral_return_deadline_days.quote: the qualified agent shall, within five business days after written notification of exoneration, return all collateral or security to the person entitled thereto.

impersonation_of_government_official_pro.quote: Making any statement that would reasonably cause another person to believe that the bail bond recovery agent is a sworn peace officer;

firearm_permit_required_for_enforcement.quote: Have a current firearms certificate issued by the commission if carrying a firearm in the performance of his or her duties as a bail bond recovery agent;

law_enforcement_notification_before_appr.quote: Notify an appropriate law enforcement agency in the local jurisdiction in which the apprehension is expected to occur.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: Nothing in this chapter is meant to prevent a bail bond agent from contacting a fugitive criminal defendant for the purpose of requesting the surrender of the fugitive, or from accepting the voluntary surrender of the fugitive.

security_deposit_required_for_company.quote: No bail bond agency license may be issued under the provisions of this chapter unless the qualified agent files with the director a bond, executed by a surety company authorized to do business in this state, in the sum of ten thousand dollars

security_deposit_minimum_amount.quote: files with the director a bond, executed by a surety company authorized to do business in this state, in the sum of ten thousand dollars

bond_register_required.quote: Every qualified agent shall keep adequate records for three years of all collateral and security received, all trust accounts required by this section, and all bail bond transactions handled by the bail bond agency, as specified by rule.

record_retention_period_years.quote: Every qualified agent shall keep adequate records for three years of all collateral and security received, all trust accounts required by this section, and all bail bond transactions handled by the bail bond agency

premium_trust_account_required.quote: Every qualified agent shall maintain a trust account in a federally insured financial institution located in this state. All moneys, including cash, checks, money orders, wire transfers, and credit card sales drafts, received as collateral or security or otherwise held for a bail bond agency's client shall be deposited in the trust account not later than the third banking day following receipt of the funds or money.

citizenship_or_work_authorization_requir.quote: Be a citizen or legal resident alien of the United States;

value: any crime in any jurisdiction if the director determines it directly relates to capacity to perform duties and license should be withheld to protect citizens
disqualifying_criminal_offenses.quote: Not have been convicted of a crime in any jurisdiction in the preceding ten years, if the director determines that the applicant's particular crime directly relates to a capacity to perform the duties of a bail bond agent and the director determines that the license should be withheld to protect the citizens of Washington state.

prelicense_education_hours.quote: The director shall adopt rules establishing prelicense training and testing requirements for bail bond agents, which shall include no less than four hours of classes.

prelicense_education_hours_classroom_req.quote: which shall include no less than four hours of classes.

bail_bond_agency_license_separate_from_a.quote: A person is guilty of a gross misdemeanor if the person owns or operates a bail bond agency in this state without first obtaining a bail bond agency license.

agency_ownership_experience_requirement.quote: Have had at least three years' experience as a manager, supervisor, or administrator in the bail bond business or a related field in Washington state as determined by the director.
